issues.detail: S03 does not specify combinational vs registered ena timing; contract fixes ena as combinational from current q.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.
issues.alternative: ena is registered and pulses on the posedge that increments the upper digit (e.g., ena[0]=1 after q 9->10 instead of while q=9 before the edge).
